summary: Core Valentine prompt and Yes->celebration state appear implemented in frontend/src/App.tsx with a pink romantic theme and a static meme image path. However, the required image asset is not shown as added, and several unrequested backend/auth-related files were introduced despite explicit non-goals.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement interactive behavior for the "No" button so that hover (desktop) and touch/pointer interaction (iPad) cause it to move before it can be clicked, staying visible and keeping the Yes button stable.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a moveNoButton() function and refs, but the App.tsx content is truncated before the button JSX/event handlers. There is no visible evidence that hover and touch/pointer events are actually wired to the No button, nor that it remains on-screen after moving.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the required static meme image asset under frontend/public/assets/generated and render it from there via a static path in the Yes success state.
missing_requirements.reason: App.tsx references the image at "/assets/generated/valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1024x1024.png", but the diff does not show the image file being added under frontend/public/assets/generated (or anywhere).

hallucinated_features.description: Backend canister code added even though no backend changes/features are required.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly states no backend canister features are required, but a backend/main.mo file was added.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication scaffolding and actor/query plumbing added despite authentication being a non-goal and the app intended to remain a simple single-page experience.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest lists user authentication (including Internet Identity) as a non-goal and says no backend features are required; yet hooks and providers for Internet Identity and actor creation were added and wrapped around the app.
